KEEPITREEL FOR DESKTOP CHROME

Getting started.

Choose your checks, learn the warning colours, and keep control of your feed.

1. Install and pin

Open the official KeepItReel Chrome Web Store listing, choose Add to Chrome and review Chrome’s permission prompt. Open Chrome’s Extensions menu and pin KeepItReel so you can see its toolbar badge.

Add to Chrome ↗

2. Choose where to check

In KeepItReel settings, open Web & message protection. Website scanning is optional. Gmail and Outlook checks need a separate opt-in. Enable suspicious-link checks if you want explanations for supported concerning link patterns.

After changing permissions, refresh the relevant page if controls do not appear. Unsupported layouts and browser-internal pages may not be checked.

3. Choose how warnings appear

Click the monkey on a supported post, inbox row or opened email to read the explanation. For a quieter layout, turn off Show monkeys on websites in the extension popup. Enabled checks continue; click the toolbar icon and choose View warnings.

The toolbar number counts distinct warning types on the current tab. It does not count individual emails, videos or blocked ads.

IndicatorWhat it means
GreenNo matching warning patterns in the completed enabled check. Not proof of safety.
Yellow / amberA disclosure, possible concern or limited coverage. Read the explanation.
RedA stronger request pattern, such as asking for a private code or payment to claim a prize. Not proof of fraud.
Grey in an inboxOnly preview information is available. No safety conclusion.
No toolbar badgeNo reported warning types. Checks may also be disabled, unsupported or awaiting access.

4. Make your feed yours

On supported YouTube videos and Shorts, open the monkey to see local analysis and choose Hide video or Block creator. Undo reverses the action. Automatic hiding of suspicious posts is a separate choice in settings.

Website checks look for explicit AI self-disclosures and visible-link patterns. They do not establish whether an entire page is human-made.

5. Tell us what needs work

Use the feedback option to suggest a feature or describe a missed or incorrect warning. Include the platform, the action you took and what you expected. Remove private messages, addresses and codes before sharing anything.

Pause, remove access or uninstall

You can pause a site and start it again, adjust source rules, and clear local data in KeepItReel settings. Chrome’s extension settings let you remove site access or uninstall. Files you exported remain on your device until you delete them.
